exposure: treatment for pregnancy-associated adenocarcinoma of the cervix
cohort: 13 patients diagnosed with cervical adenocarcinoma or adenosquamous carcinoma during pregnancy or within 6 weeks postpartum at a single institution between 1990 and 2009
finding: Treatment patterns for pregnancy-associated cervical adenocarcinoma or adenosquamous carcinoma resulted in good clinical outcomes, suggesting that treatment can be delayed until after delivery unless advanced stage disease is diagnosed early in pregnancy.
